Answer First

Answer First workflow for coding agents. Use when a direct question needs an answer before context.

Task Decomposition workflow for coding agents. Use when a large task needs manageable steps.

Progress State

Progress State workflow for coding agents. Use when work spans multiple turns or stages.

Partial Success

Partial Success workflow for coding agents. Use when some checks passed and others failed.

Evidence Aware Errors workflow for coding agents. Use when an error needs a factual report.

Debug Hypotheses workflow for coding agents. Use when a failure has multiple plausible explanations.

Resolve Ambiguity workflow for coding agents. Use when a required target or constraint is missing.

Decision Support workflow for coding agents. Use when the user needs to choose between alternatives.

Resume Context workflow for coding agents. Use when work resumes after a break.

Scope Control workflow for coding agents. Use when related work threatens to distract from the active task.
